a.text: I'll operate in round 1 as we agreed. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we're both likely to be caught short. I'm open to discussing a fair change to the plan, but I won't take any cells unless we both agree to it first. Please tell me honestly what you plan to do.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take 4.
Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as we agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
